runtime_evidence_additional_requirements: pass must be true and runtime git SHA must match the input manifest
runtime_map_parity must be true after comparing actual ROS /map frame, resolution, origin, orientation and every cell with frozen YAML/PGM
raw aligned JSONL and observed wind CSV must exist and match their SHA256 values
require bootstrap t=0 plus at least eight positive 0.2s aligned frames; t=0 wind is not an observation
recompute frame count, cadence, finite values, wind CSV stamps/pose/vectors and wind free-space probe identity
block YAML origins are supported; unsupported nonzero yaw is rejected, never silently ignored
shared arm token binds future arm input requirements; it is not evidence that four scientific arms executed
stationary endpoint+dwell proves point feasibility only, not general path-planning performance
purpose: Bind the three Houses to auditable geometry, coordinate, local-wind, clock and route identities before formal M1/M2/M3 validation. This is an input-contract gate, not a GMRF accuracy gate.

free_space_probe_contract.rule: Every audited candidate, local-wind observation and route probe point must map inside the declared navigation-height occupancy image and be free under that map YAML's negate/free_thresh semantics. The same geometry identity must be used by data generation, baselines and CSTAR.

hard_rules: The runtime-loaded map YAML/image hashes must exactly equal the frozen House geometry hashes.
world/candidate/route/source-estimate frames must all be map.
wind must be represented as local stamped downwind u,v in m/s at the observation pose; no hidden upwind +pi conversion is allowed in the CSTAR input path.
cadence must equal the frozen input cadence.
old_native_gmrf_anemometer_subscription_used must be false for the explicit CSTAR input path; GMRF may remain an optional named offline/baseline component only if independently audited.

required_equalities: same pose/gas/local-wind topic semantics and cadence
same coordinate transform and navigation height
same source truth and simulator world identity within a paired comparison
same route feasibility/navigation stack unless the scientific arm explicitly changes route selection
no arm receives a corrected map/wind interface while another arm keeps the known legacy mismatch

known_review_reference_only.warning: These H01 values came from an isolated diagnostic and do not themselves prove that a future runtime loaded them. H02/H03 have no equivalent frozen values in this contract until VM alignment is performed.
